briefingAdmin.listHint: Review validated ko drafts and publish them. Publishing also publishes the en/zh drafts translated from that ko version and replaces the date's current edition.
briefingAdmin.noTranslations: No en/zh drafts were translated from this version. Publishing it publishes ko only and takes down the date's current en/zh editions.
briefingAdmin.confirmPublish: Publish {date} ko v{version} and its translations? The date's current edition will be replaced.
briefingAdmin.confirmWithdraw: Withdraw the published {date} edition (all languages)? A withdrawn edition cannot be republished from here.
briefingAdmin.confirmRegenerate: Regenerate {date}? This calls the LLM (about $0.01–0.02, 15–60 s) and creates a new draft version.
briefingAdmin.editTitle: Edit text (saved as a new draft version)
briefingAdmin.editHint: Only the headline, lede and top-story text can be edited. The same validator runs before saving; nothing is saved if a fatal issue remains.
briefingAdmin.saveEdit: Validate and save as new version
briefingAdmin.editOnlyKo: Text can only be edited on the ko version.
briefingAdmin.preview: Preview (same component as the public page)
briefingAdmin.notRenderable: This version has no content (failed or skipped).
briefingAdmin.dataQualityBody: This edition's period includes days with incomplete collection ({days}). Those weekdays are excluded from same-weekday comparisons, but figures may change after backfill. It can be published only after you acknowledge this.
briefingAdmin.dataQualityAck: I have reviewed the data notice and want to publish as is
briefingAdmin.weeklyEditNote: Inline editing isn't available for weekly reports yet. If something needs fixing, regenerate or don't publish.

briefingAdmin.confirmRegenerateWeekly: Regenerate the {week} weekly report? This calls the LLM (about $0.003–0.008, 10–40 s) and creates a new draft version.
briefingAdmin.previewWeekly: Preview (same component as the public weekly page)

weekly.coverage: Based on {total} public AI articles · {minutes} min read
weekly.aiDisclosure: Figures are computed from our database; the text was written by AI citing only those figures and articles.
weekly.dataNotice: Only {days} were collected (same-weekday-group median {median}). Week-over-week article counts exclude that weekday in both weeks. Once collection is backfilled, this report will be recalculated and changes logged under “Corrections”.
weekly.dailyConclusion: Comparing the same weekdays, article volume changed {change} from last week.
weekly.chartEntitiesDesc: Articles naming the company in the title or summary. Changes are shown only when both weeks have 5 or more. {mark} = Chinese company or institution.
weekly.entitiesNote: Mention counts reflect coverage by {count} Chinese outlets, not market share or performance.
weekly.chartRisingDesc: Up 3 or more from last week and at least 4 this week.
weekly.chartFallingDesc: Down 3 or more from at least 4 last week.
weekly.barsDesc: Bar = this week, tick = last week.
weekly.sentFlat: Changes are within 1 percentage point, so we don't treat them as a trend.
weekly.chinaSection: China and overseas, as seen by Chinese media
weekly.chartChina: Share of articles naming Chinese vs overseas players
weekly.chartChinaDesc: This week {foreign}% of articles named an overseas company and {china}% a Chinese company or institution (last week {pforeign}% vs {pchina}%).
weekly.chartChinaDescNoPrev: {foreign}% of articles named an overseas company and {china}% a Chinese company or institution.
weekly.chinaNote: Articles naming both are counted on both sides.
weekly.chinaLensDropped: The AI commentary for this section failed validation, so only the figures are shown.
weekly.moneySub: Amounts as stated in headlines · not summed or converted
weekly.moneyEmpty: No headline this week stated a deal amount.
weekly.moneyNote: Reported amounts extracted automatically from headlines. Revenue and valuation figures are excluded; a deal reported by several outlets appears on several rows. Not investment advice.
weekly.pinyinVariants: Articles spell the pinyin {count} ways; we show the most common one.
weekly.methodBody: Population: public AI articles (business, tech, product), dated by Beijing time. Company names in Korean, Chinese and English are counted under one label. Reposts of the same article are grouped by title similarity, and reports of the same event are grouped again. Days with incomplete collection are excluded from same-weekday comparisons.
weekly.methodMeta: Figures computed {computed} UTC · {prompt} · published after editor approval
weekly.fixesNone: None yet. If backfilled collection changes the figures, the previous edition and the changed figures will be listed here.
weekly.footer: This report was written by AI using only articles from {count} Chinese outlets ({outlets}) and computed figures, and reviewed by an editor. It is not investment advice.
weekly.localeMissingTitle: This weekly report isn't available in English
weekly.localeMissingBody: The {week} weekly report is available in:
weekly.emptyTitle: No weekly report has been published yet
weekly.emptyBody: Weekly reports are published every Monday for the previous week. Meanwhile, read the daily briefing.
